gate_1_gauge.content: tree gauge-fixing is exact on a connected graph (no Gribov obstruction), leaving b_1 = E-V+1 holonomies and residual diagonal G acting by conjugation => gauge-invariant states = L^2(G^{b_1})^Ad; for B_3 this IS the carrier used by YM-1..10, now certified rather than assumed

gate_2_volume_ir.free: free reduced gap = C_(1/2) = 3/4 for every n and every a — volume- and cutoff-uniform
gate_2_volume_ir.interacting: sandwich gives Delta >= C_(1/2) - 2 F(n) theta; F(n) = n(n-1)/2 so degradation is quadratic in n. PROVEN INSUFFICIENT for volume-uniformity
gate_2_volume_ir.verdict: SPLIT — free CLOSED, interacting route INSUFFICIENT
gate_2_volume_ir.what_a_replacement_must_do: control the interaction per-plaquette rather than by a global sup — the dock route (YM-6) not the envelope route (YM-5), one level up

gate_3_universality.counting_layer: content grading, multiplicity law, carrier dimensions, blindness ledger and probe counts depend only on SU(2) representation theory, not on (c_j): identical for every regulator in the class

metric_layer.note: physical universality would require agreement after renormalization along the asymptotically-free trajectory — NOT modelled, NOT claimed

gate_3_universality.regulator_class: K(g) = sum_j d_j c_j chi_j(g), c_0 = 1, c_j > 0 — includes heat kernel and Wilson
gate_3_universality.verdict: SPLIT — counting layer CLOSED, metric layer OPEN
